```{r packages}

install.packages(c("baseballr", "dplyr", "purrr", "ggplot2", "scales"))
library(baseballr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
```

```{r parameters and columns}
  
seasons <- 2015:2025
#2015 - 2025 seasons
window_start <- "08-15" 
#month-day the window starts
window_days <- 7 
#length of window in days
team <- "CWS" 
#I'm a lifelong White Sox fan, so I'm looking to compare them

columns <- c("game_date", "game_year", "pitch_type",
             "pitch_name", "home_team", "away_team", "inning_topbot")
```

```{r date}

statcast_day <- function(d) {
  Sys.sleep(1)
  out <- tryCatch(
    statcast_search(start_date = as.character(d),
                    end_date = as.character(d),
                    player_type = "pitcher"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(out) || nrow(out) == 0) return(NULL)
  out |>
    select (any_of(columns)) |>
    mutate(game_date = as.Date(game_date))
}
#downloads and fixes one day of data.
# d = date passed into function
#out = raw statcast result for the day


date <- do.call(c, map(seasons, ~ seq(as.Date(paste0(.x,
"-", window_start)),
                                    by = "day",
                                    length.out = window_days)))
```

```{r data}

raw <- map_dfr(date, statcast_day)
#combined data frame of every pitch from every sampled day

saveRDS(raw, "statcast_pitch_sample.rds")
raw <- readRDS("statcast_pitch_sample.rds")
#save


pitches <- raw |>
  mutate(
    pitching_team = if_else(inning_topbot == "Top", home_team, away_team),
    pitch_group = case_when(
      pitch_type == "FF"  ~  "Four-seam",
      pitch_type %in% c("SI", "FT")  ~ "Sinker / Two-seam",
      pitch_type == "FC"   ~ "Cutter",
      pitch_type %in% c("SL", "ST")   ~ "Slider / Sweeper",
      pitch_type == "SV"   ~ "Slurve",
      pitch_type %in% c("CU", "KC", "CS") ~ "Curveball",
      pitch_type == "CH"   ~ "Changeup",
      pitch_type %in% c("FS", "FO")  ~ "Splitter",
      TRUE    ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  filter (!is.na(pitch_group))
#cleaned dataset, raw with 2 new columns added and unusable removed. 

#Curveball: CU, KC, and CS, variations of curveball
#Sinker / Two-Seam: statcast labeled differently in certain years

#rare occurrences are removed (knuckleballs, automatic balls, intentional balls)

```

```{r change from 2015 to 2025 - league}

league_mix <- pitches |>
  count(game_year, pitch_group) |>
  group_by(game_year) |>
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup()

league_mix


#summary table of one row for each combination of season and pitch group 
#showing what share of that season's pitches were what type.

#league change over seasons
league_change <- league_mix |> 
  filter(game_year %in% c(2015, 2025)) |>
  select(game_year, pitch_group, pct) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = game_year,
                     values_from = pct,
                     values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(change_pts = (`2025` - `2015`) * 100) |>
  arrange(desc(change_pts))

league_change

change_table <- league_change |> 
  transmute(`Pitch Type` = pitch_group,
            `2015 (% of pitches)` = round(`2015` * 100, 2),
            `2025 (% of pitches)` = round(`2025` * 100, 2),
            `Change (percentage points)` = round(change_pts, 2))
change_table

```
```{r change from from 2015-2025 - team}

team_mix <- pitches |>
  filter(pitching_team == team) |>
  count(game_year, pitch_group) |>
  group_by(game_year) |>
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup()

team_change <- team_mix |>
  filter(game_year %in% c(2015, 2025)) |>
  select(game_year, pitch_group, pct) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = game_year,
                     values_from = pct,
                     values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(change_pts = (`2025` - `2015`) *100) |>
  arrange(desc(change_pts))

team_change

team_change_table <- team_change |> 
  transmute(`Pitch Type` = pitch_group,
            `2015 (% of pitches)` = round(`2015` * 100, 2),
            `2025 (% of pitches)` = round(`2025` * 100, 2),
            `Change (percentage points)` = round(change_pts, 2))
team_change_table

```

```{r visualizations}

p_league <- ggplot(league_mix,
                   aes(x = game_year, y = pct, color = pitch_group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seasons) +
  labs(title = "MLB Pitch Mix by Season",
       subtitle = paste0("Sample: ", window_days, " days starting ",
                         window_start, " each year"),
       x = "Season", y = "Share of pitches", color = "Pitch type") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("league_pitch_mix.png", p_league, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

p_league
#line chart, each pitch type gets its own color, indicating share of overall
#pitches over span of time


p_area <- ggplot(league_mix,
                 aes(x = game_year, y = pct, fill = pitch_group)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seasons) +
  labs(title = "MLB Pitch Mix Make-Up",
       x = "Season", y = "Share of pitches", fill = "Pitch type") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("league_pitch_mix_area.png", p_area, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

p_area
#stacked area chart of p_league, adding up to 100%
#shows composition of pitch usage at first glance
```

```{r sliders and sweepers}

breaking_trend <- pitches |>
  mutate(in_slider_grouping = pitch_group %in% c("Slider / Sweeper")) |>
  group_by(game_year) |>
  summarize(pct = mean(in_slider_grouping), .groups = "drop")
breaking_trend

p_breaking <- ggplot(breaking_trend, aes(game_year,pct)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, color = 'steelblue') +
  geom_point(size = 2) + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seasons) +
  labs(title = 'Slider and Sweeper Usage Across MLB',
       x = 'Season', 
       y = 'Distribution of all Pitches') + 
  theme_minimal()

p_breaking
```

```{r team vs. league}

team_mix <- pitches |> 
  filter(pitching_team == team) |>
  count(game_year, pitch_group) |>
  group_by(game_year) |>
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(scope = team)

compare <- bind_rows(league_mix |> mutate(scope = 'League'), team_mix)

p_team <- ggplot(compare, 
                 aes(x = game_year, 
                     y = pct,
                     color = scope)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ pitch_group, scales = 'free_y') +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(seasons), max(seasons), by = 2)) +
  labs(title = paste0(team, ' vs. League Pitch Distribution'), 
       x = 'Season',
       y = 'Distribution of Pitches',
       color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()

p_team

```
